# Walter Burley Griffin and the design of Canberra

Published: 2022-03-30

An international competition for the design of the new capital was held in 1911.

- Walter Burley Griffin and Marion Mahony Griffin won the 1912 design competition for Canberra.
- The Griffins' plan was built around a central artificial lake, later named Lake Burley Griffin.
- Parliament moved from Melbourne to Canberra in 1927.
